First of all:

I KNOW NOTHING about the contents of upcoming sets, expansions, designer's minds,
the origins of the universe, etc and this is all supposition on my part but....
Also: I am not associated with White-wolf, Wizards, or any other organization that you can
think of. These organizations are of course free to use anything I say in what ways they wish
including my supposed subtitle for anarachs (see below)

Second Point:
I've already sold my soul for 2 complete sets of !Tremere. Consider that to be my
stated bias. (Am currently attempting to sell my soul for succubus and Nephandus)

Having said that...

I would guess that the !Tremere will not see a resurgance barring
them being forced back into the World of Darkness via a Storyline event.
(go !Tremere).

I would think that WW would continue their current trend of popping the occasional
one or two out per expansion (as done in FN, CE). As for reprinting them I would guess
no (but boy have I been wrong before).

Part of it depends on the group numbers thing. Looking at anarchs and further
down the road where sabbat vampires might again be the focus of a set if they
were to be reprinted would they retain their "group 2" status? The current sabbat
only vamps are group 2, as are Goratrix and that so nice 5 cap from Final Nights,
the new one in CE is group 3 of course.

Reprinting the !Tremere from group 2 would create expectations of a reprint
of all group 2 sabbat, and I'm hoping this is in the distant future (like after I'm
too old to see the cards anymore)

More likely is that new !Tremere will appear, perhaps enough to play by
themselves. (10-12) and I would think that this would only occur after anarchs.
(Although I guess there is the possibility that all the !Tremere were not really
destroyed and that they all really went undercover and joined the anarchs and
that this next expansion will be their coming out party and will bear the subtitle:
"Thaumaturgical ways to gain revenge for having to hide for several years after
faking being turned into pillars of ash".

Once again I will refer you to the disclaimer at the start of my post. =)

Regards,
-JTP

Spoiler space just in case you do not want to know what is up with the !Tremere, Goratrix, etc.

It went something like Saulot's soul entered Tremere's body through diab
(pesky antidiluvials) and slept within the body for centuries, Somewhere a while back
Saulot's soul awoke and they struggled for control of the body of Tremere. (some Vicsiss in
Tremere's blood manifested itself by shaping Tremere's features to match whomever was
winning at the time, while the body slept in Torpor.)
Around 1988 Saulot won, and consciously used viciss to match Tremere's face to that of his
old body (but some Tremere remembered what they saw). He then decided to
rest for a while.
Tremere's soul escaped to inhabit Goratrix's body (his once faithful disciple)

Tremere decided he did not want to go through the whole battle of souls thing again and
put Goratrix's soul into a mirror in Tremere's study.

Why did Tremere, as Goratrix destroy the !Tremere? White-wolf left that up to invididual
storytellers.(did suggest some motives however)

(Info From Nights of Prophecy)

-JTP
